note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. An exploded view of a petition passing to a prior-examination tray along a path configured between abstract stations: plates of the same size on one row (no rank, level or hierarchy), their neutral two-slot trays (the brief's 'filtros' drawn as trays, never as an admission gate; the last stop's is the prior-examination tray, marked only by a plain tab), the numbered steps of the supplied sequence, the placeholder petition and the supplied state (● authorization requested / ◆ decision supplied — equal weight; the decision is a placeholder sheet whose content is never shown). Only the supplied relationships are drawn; a plain relation has no arrowhead and causal links appear only when supplied. No criterion, threshold, time limit, outcome (granted / refused / admitted) or jurisdiction is drawn. Brief fields: decisions, routes, outcomes, elements, relationships, focusElement, relationLabels and traversalOrder are editable (suppliedState chooses the state shown). OMITTED brief field: grounds — grounds of a request would add legal content (criteria) the mechanism must not draw. The 'calendario' object of the brief is left out of the exploded view: no time element is supplied, and a calendar beside a request could be read as a time limit.
